fact: CIPIT (Strathmore University) states that Uganda has no AI laws in place and uses data protection laws in place of a dedicated framework; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.

The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and ITU assessment lists a lack of AI policy, legal and regulatory framework among its major findings and recommends Uganda develop one; the document gives only its year, 2025, as its date.
